Clarification of News : The press had reports that LIC Housing Finance Ltd planned to buy Corporations Bank's housing finance business. The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the press and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company.
